FEMA NFHL Orleans Parish extract: /root/.cache/hifld-qgis-agent-errors/nfhl/22071C/S_FLD_HAZ_AR.shp (filtered to SFHA_TF = 'T')
output.method: I downloaded the HIFLD nursing-homes GeoPackage and kept the 29 facilities with COUNTYFIPS 22071 and STATE LA. I then selected the NFHL flood hazard polygons flagged SFHA_TF = 'T' (2,205 polygons) and ran an intersect test, which left 3 facilities. Note that the HIFLD dataset also includes assisted living facilities, so these are the dataset's nursing-home/assisted-care records.
